phase: Week 9 Phase 1.23 - pre-registered synthetic stress test of the frozen Phase 1.21 policies
purpose: map where the frozen boundary-conditioned coverage rule helps, is equivalent to, or hurts plain M3 margin; not to make it win
no_tuning: pad 0.25, pad floor 0.05, uncertainty weight 1, switch B40, k_seed 8 and standardised-x coverage coordinates are the Phase 1.21 values; M3 is the Phase 1.13 fit_hybrid object; nothing is tuned on synthetic or SPH results
sph_data_used_to_choose_settings: no. Synthetic inputs, physics direction, units, prevalence, pool size and families were fixed from first principles. Inherited from the frozen method only: budgets 16-80, the B40 switch and the absolute pad floor 0.05 (in h units)
known_scale_dependence: pad_floor 0.05 is absolute in h units; here SD(h) = 0.289, so the floor is 0.17 SD(h)

generator.orthogonal_coordinates: z_j = q_j.(x - 1/2), q_1..q_3 an orthonormal basis of u-perp (QR of [u, e1, e2, e3])
generator.displacement_field: random Fourier features (1000) of an RBF-kernel GP with length-scale l, standardised to mean 0 / SD 1 on the reference set

families.fold (F4): y = 1[h - a SD(h) delta(x - 1/2) > t], delta over all 4 inputs (non-monotone in h), l 0.15
families.islands (F5): y = 1[h > t0] XOR [x inside one of k balls of radius 0.2 centred where 1.2r <= |h - t0| <= 3r]
families.rotated (F6): y = 1[cos(theta) h + sin(theta) z_1 > t]; the physics coordinate is wrong by angle theta

generator.threshold: t = (1 - prevalence) quantile of the score on the reference set

per_function_sets.pool: i.i.d. candidates (400; 1000 in two sensitivity cells)
per_function_sets.test: 4000 i.i.d. points, independent of the pool
per_function_sets.reference: 100000 i.i.d. points used only for boundary distances and thresholds

generator.boundary_distance: Euclidean distance (x units) from a test point to the nearest reference point of the opposite class
generator.near_boundary_subsets: q20 / q30 = the 20% / 30% of test points with the smallest boundary distance (ties by index); the SPH B1 idea applied to a dense independent test set
generator.seeds: sha256-derived from ('week9_phase1_23', 'truth', cell_id, function index); maximin seed from ('maximin', cell, index); random order from ('random', cell, index); physics fit seed per budget
generator.replication_unit: independently generated ground-truth function (own field, threshold, pool, test and reference sets); no function is reused across cells

design.initial_design: seeded greedy maximin order over the pool in standardised x (Week 8.5 rule); a policy with seed size k takes the first k points and extends along the same order until both classes are queried

policies.random: frozen 16-point seed, then a seeded random order
policies.margin: CONTROL: frozen 16-point seed, M3 probability margin
policies.early8__coverage_then_margin_B40: CANDIDATE B (frozen): 8-point seed + Candidate A's rule
policies.early8__margin: ABLATION: 8-point seed + margin (separates initial-design from acquisition effects)
policies.global_unc_div_then_margin_B40: LITERATURE ANALOGUE / ABLATION: the frozen rank(uncertainty) + rank(distance) score over ALL candidates (no label-estimated h-band) until B40, then margin (sequential uncertainty + diversity, cf. Brinker 2003)
policies.straddle: LITERATURE BASELINE (cells ['F7_exact', 'S_a0.3_l0.5_d3', 'S_a0.6_l0.2_d3', 'F4_fold_a0.6', 'F5_islands_k8', 'F6_rot60'] only): Bryan et al. 2005 straddle 1.96 sd - |mean| on the M3 latent

endpoints.primary_map: q20 accuracy AULC over budgets 16-80 and 16-40, candidate minus margin, per function
endpoints.co_primary_global: global accuracy AULC 16-80 and 16-40 (1 - volume of the symmetric difference, estimated on the dense test set)
secondary: error depth q95 (95th percentile boundary distance of misclassified test points) at B40 and B80
endpoints.aulc: trapezoid over integer budgets divided by (hi - lo)
ablation_contrasts: B - early8__margin (acquisition value under the early start)

inference.unit: function (independent ground truth), paired across policies
inference.estimate: mean paired difference; 95% percentile bootstrap CI (10,000 draws over functions); 90% CI for equivalence
inference.test: two-sided sign-flip permutation of paired differences (10,000 draws)
inference.multiplicity: Holm over the 80 primary tests {A, B} x {q20 AULC 16-80, 16-40} x 20 core cells; unadjusted CIs are also reported

classification.equivalence_margin_rationale: 0.5 percentage point of AULC; the SPH pure-acquisition effect (+0.0032) would itself fall inside this margin

inference.phase_diagram: mean A - margin (and B - margin) per cell as heatmaps over amplitude x length x heterogeneity dimension, plus a family strip
inference.validity_map: per function: A - margin against the truth's best-1D-h-threshold error (label structure only), binned by quintile with bootstrap CIs; and an OLS of A - margin on amplitude, length, het_dim within the shift family with HC3 standard errors (descriptive)
mechanism_post_hoc: share of runs whose queried labels are still separable in h by budget
share of B16-39 queries inside the estimated band
share of steps differing from margin
band width as share of the pool

predictions_from_theory_note.P1: physics_exact (F7, both sensitivity versions): A and B not better than margin on q20 AULC 16-40 (EQUIVALENT or HURTS); margin behaves as bisection in h, which is optimal for a 1D threshold
predictions_from_theory_note.P2: F1 (a = 0.1): no material help (EQUIVALENT, HELPS_SMALL or small HURTS)
predictions_from_theory_note.P3: shift cells with a >= 0.3 (8 cells): A - margin > 0 on q20 AULC 16-40 in the majority; larger for a = 0.6 than a = 0.3 and for d = 3 than d = 1 (directional); no directional prediction for length-scale
predictions_from_theory_note.P4: where A helps, |A - margin| on 41-80 is smaller than on 16-40
predictions_from_theory_note.P5: F6 rotated: no systematic help from band conditioning; A - global_unc_div <= 0 at 60 and 90 degrees; A - margin not predicted
predictions_from_theory_note.P6: F5 islands: A - margin EQUIVALENT (islands lie outside the band)
predictions_from_theory_note.P7: F4 fold: no confident prediction; weakly A >= margin at a = 0.6
predictions_from_theory_note.P8: shift cells with a >= 0.3: A - global_unc_div > 0 (the band adds value over global diversity)
predictions_from_theory_note.P9: early8__margin - margin > 0 in most cells; B - early8__margin has the sign of A - margin
predictions_from_theory_note.P10: straddle - margin approximately 0 under M3's steep physics mean in F7; no prediction elsewhere

overall_verdict_rules.A_GENERALISES_IN_PREDICTED_REGION: A is HELPS_* in >= 4 of the 8 shift cells with a >= 0.3 (q20 AULC 16-40) and is not HURTS with mean <= -0.005 in F1 or F7
overall_verdict_rules.A_SPH_SPECIFIC: A is HELPS_* in <= 1 of those 8 cells
overall_verdict_rules.BAND_CONDITIONING_MATTERS: A - global_unc_div has 95% CI > 0 in >= 4 of those 8 cells (q20 AULC 16-40)

pre_freeze_activity_disclosed: timing smoke on 5 separate smoke cells (outputs/.../synthetic_smoke; ids never used in the grid); only runtimes and seed sizes were inspected
generator validity gate on function 0 (and 1 for islands) of every cell: prevalence, class counts, q20 class share, best-1D-threshold error; no policy was involved
island radius changed from 0.12 to 0.2 after the gate showed 0.2-0.75% flipped volume (islands unreachable by any policy); decided from label structure only
toy checks for the theory note on separate random data: C = 1e6 logistic threshold at the gap midpoint; M3 margin choice near the midpoint in h
